notes: Upstream-clone bugfix in starship/starship (v4.2 family): an empty prompt format textgroup such as [](bg:#9A348E) is dropped entirely at parse time, so it can never establish the style that a later segment references through prev_fg/prev_bg; [](bg:red)[X](bg:prev_bg) renders a plain 'X' with no background. No crash or error message names the fault: the symptom is a missing ANSI escape, so the agent must read the prompt formatter machinery (src/formatter/*) to localise it. Build/reproduce/localise/patch/verify chain against the real tree with warm caches and 1 vCPU. Verifier: provenance (only src/formatter/string_formatter.rs may differ, blob-level against the pinned parent commit, and the fix commit must not be reachable) + the project's own regression tests for the bug (three inline mod tests extracted from the fix commit at image build time into /opt/golden and planted into the tree by the verifier) + a selection of the project's own existing string-formatter unit tests + four authored hidden CLI cases with different styles/chains plus a fifth hidden CLI case generated at verify time with a random hex colour (expected bytes computed by formula), so no static enumeration of inputs can pass. Oracle applies an authored one-function patch that mirrors the upstream fix (emit one zero-width styled segment for an empty textgroup).
